{{Quote|Torture me as you must, but it won't change the fact that we came to Obroa-skai on business.|The captain of the ''Reticent'', to [[Anakin Skywalker|Darth Vader]]|<ref name="Tarkin" />}}
'''Obroa-skai''' was a [[planet]] located in the [[Obroa-skai system]]<ref name="Tarkin" /> of [[the galaxy]]'s [[Inner Rim Territories|Inner Rim]].<ref name="Appendix" /> The [[Vaathkree Trade Corridor]] connected it to [[Contruum]] and [[Ubduria]].<ref name="Vaathkree" /> It was known mostly for its [[Library|libraries]] and [[medcenter]]s. At the end of the [[Clone Wars]], [[Obroa-skai emergency medevac center|one]] of those medcenters bought a [[fleet]] of [[Sephi flyer]]s from [[Thustra]] for use during emergency evacuations.<ref name="Tarkin" /> [[Galen Walton Erso]] served as a [[teacher]] at a [[Obroa-skai College|college]] on the planet.<ref name="Rebel Dossier" />

In [[14 BBY]], [[Berch Teller]] and his [[Berch Teller's rebel cell|rebel cell]] transmitted disinformation that they were traveling on [[Moff]] [[Wilhuff Tarkin]]'s stolen corvette ''[[Carrion Spike]]'' to Obroa-skai. In response, the Empire diverted considerable resources including three [[interdictor]] vessels to apprehend the insurgents. The [[Immobilizer 418 cruiser]]'s [[gravity well projector]]s malfunctioned, triggering a [[Incident in the Obroa-skai system|space accident]] involving several ships that claimed the lives of 1,100 passengers aboard the [[MC80 Star Cruiser]] ''[[Stellar Vista]]''. Following the accident, the surviving ships were towed to Obroa-skai's shipyards for repairs.<ref name="Tarkin" />

Around [[0 ABY]],<ref name="Smuggler's Guide Date">[[Cornelius Evazan]]'s entry in ''[[Star Wars: Smuggler's Guide]]'' states how [[Ponda Baba]] lost an arm a while ago. ''[[Star Wars: Galactic Atlas]]'' dates the events of [[Star Wars: Episode IV A New Hope|''Star Wars'': Episode IV ''A New Hope'']] to [[0 ABY]].</ref> the [[Obroa-skai's Stratosphere Room]] on the planet was the location of the [[Obroan Intelligence Summit]], a meeting of [[information broker]]s.<ref name="Smuggler's Guide" />

==Behind the scenes==
Obroa-skai first appeared in ''[[Heir to the Empire]]'', a [[1991]] [[Star Wars Legends|''Star Wars'' Legends]] novel written by [[Timothy Zahn]] as the first entry in [[Star Wars: The Thrawn Trilogy|''The Thrawn Trilogy'']].<ref name="Heir to the Empire">''[[Heir to the Empire]]''</ref> It became [[canon]] when it appeared in [[Tarkin (novel)|''Tarkin'']], a novel written by [[James Luceno]]<ref name="Tarkin" /> that was released on [[November 4]], [[2014]].<ref name="Tarkin release date">{{RandomHouseOld|url=book/7871/tarkin-star-wars-by-james-luceno|text=Tarkin: Star Wars}}</ref>
